body:
Hola gente bueno somos un team que recien comezamos en avicus, sin embargo cada uno de nuestros jugadores son experimentados en Overcast Network.
- El team no se va a disolver.
- somos serios.
- Somos un equipo prometedor.
- MUY straters.

Bueno si estan interesados necesito que me llenen este formulario para ver con quien estoy hablando:

▪Edad[no importa mientras seas maduro]:
▪Nacionalidad/Pais:
▪skype:
▪Posicion:
▪Experiencia en el server:
▪haz jugado algun torneo:
▪algo mas que nos auieras decir:


PD: No nos fijamos en stats.
Roster: https://avicus.net/teams/401#membersTab

Hello guys we are a new team which we resently started, but all of our members are experimented in playing similar servers for example Octc.
- The team isnt going to disolve.
- We are serious.
- We'll have a good future.
- Very Straters.

Well guys if you are interested in joining we'll need you to fill out this:
• Age [We need maturity]:
• Country/Nationality:
• skype: 
• Position:
• Experience in this server:
• Did you participated in any tournaments:
• Can you talk/Understand spanish?:

PD: Feel free to post we dont look into stats.
This is our actual roster: https://avicus.net/teams/401#membersTab
